view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a warehouse aisle with polished concrete floors and exposed ceiling infrastructure. Stacks of palletized boxes are centrally located, while an orange forklift is partially visible on the right. Yellow safety barriers line the left side, and a numbered sign '2' hangs overhead. Lighting fixtures illuminate the space, and a doorway reveals another area in the background.

objects.label: palletized boxes
objects.observation: Multiple stacks of dark blue boxes wrapped in plastic, resting on wooden pallets. Positioned centrally in the aisle, they appear organized and stationary. No direct contact with other objects except the ground. Occluded by the forklift on the right and safety barriers on the left.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange and gray forklift, partially visible on the right edge of the frame. Its mast and part of the cabin are seen. It appears to be parked or stationary. The front bumper rests on the floor, and its body is adjacent to yellow safety barriers. No visible attachments or cargo.

objects.label: yellow safety barriers
objects.observation: Yellow horizontal rails mounted on black posts, positioned along the left side of the aisle. They run parallel to the camera’s perspective. Some barriers are near the boxes, others further back. They appear freestanding and do not seem to connect to any wall or ceiling.

objects.label: ceiling-mounted light fixture
objects.observation: Long fluorescent light fixtures suspended from the warehouse ceiling. They are evenly spaced along the ceiling beams. Illuminating the aisle, their ends are visible at different angles. No visible mounting hardware beyond the ceiling structure.

objects.label: numbered sign
objects.observation: A white rectangular sign with the number '2' in black, hanging from the ceiling above the aisle. It is positioned near the center-left of the frame. The sign is attached to a beam or support structure, but the exact mounting point is not clearly visible.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: A rectangular opening in a white wall, revealing a brightly lit interior space behind it. Inside, red furniture or equipment is visible. The doorway is framed by the wall and does not appear to have any visible door or frame details.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32850", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
